scope: Nine selected armor-set routes, eight of them with direct Infusion recipes, plus shared player equipment dispatch. Static evidence, no game execution.

alacrity.summary: The full-set invulnerability callback checks the fall-damage tag. The partial-set incoming-damage callback checks only absence of FULL_SET before adding an armor-stage reduction; it has no fall-source guard in this method. Its lambda uses equippedPieces.size × 0.2.
alacrity.status: Tooltip/implementation scope mismatch requiring target-build review; no observed combat bug or applied fix.

embrodium.summary: Server-player tick callback reads Spirit per-tick regeneration (fallback 0.04). Full set adds 0.25×regen. Above ambient temperature 0.8, it additionally adds perPieceValue(0.25×regen)×min(1,temperature/2); only positive totals are submitted. This is an extra resource request, not a measured final recovery rate.

hazmat.summary: FULL_SET plus air below maximum triggers setting air to maximum. The airtight helmet method separately calls PlayerUtil.isWearingFullSet for its material.

ice.summary: Server-side inventoryTick requires numeric slotId 36–40 inclusive, a LivingEntity wearer, damage>0, random nextFloat<0.02 and ambient temperature<0.15. It then subtracts one damage point. These are callback gates, not proof that every engine inventory slot invokes this hook identically.

infernal.summary: Incoming damage must match IS_FIRE before adding a reduction with perPieceValue(0.15). Full-set fire-tag invulnerability is a separate callback. The reduction helper acts on remaining damage at its stage.

lyndamyte.summary: Retaliation requires positive new damage, server side, a melee source and a RandomUtil.percentChance call with perPieceValue(0.25); it requests five seconds of fire on the source entity. Full-set outgoing melee attacks separately request five seconds of fire on the target. External random-helper semantics and final immunity/hooks remain separate.

skeletal.summary: For a ServerPlayer with saturation<1 and FULL_SET, the callback saves the food level, calls FoodData.eat(1,0.5), then restores the food level. This is saturation maintenance rather than a direct command to set a full hunger bar.

void.summary: Requires positive new damage, a LivingEntity attacker and a melee source. RandomUtil.percentChance receives 0.2 for FULL_SET, otherwise perPieceValue(0.025). Successful calls build MOVEMENT_SLOWDOWN with duration input 30 and level input 20 for the attacker. The full-set branch is a total input, not a second additive random roll.
void.status: Selected branch checked; EffectBuilder level/duration interpretation not reimplemented

wither.summary: Incoming reduction requires the IS_WITHER tag and perPieceValue(0.25). Full set plus that tag sets invulnerability and builds DAMAGE_RESISTANCE with duration input 60, ambient and hidden-icon flags. The effect is requested on a qualifying damage check, not merely because a status-effect icon exists.

shared_rules: Equipment-change events set a flag; the pre-player-tick handler returns for dead or spectator players, processes changed equipment, checks equipment requirements, then invokes one armor tick callback per stored material container.
Material grouping and FULL_SET are separate from raw slot count. perPieceValue subtracts the FULL_SET sentinel from the EnumSet size.
Compatible-with-any-set pieces affect full-set recognition; do not assume their material containers contribute every ordinary per-piece bonus.
DamageUtil.percentDamageReduction returns existingReduction+(newDamage-existingReduction)*fraction; it is not a flat reduction of original pre-pipeline damage.
acceptance: Test one, two, three and four ordinary pieces with fall versus non-fall Alacrity damage; reconcile tooltip or implementation only after deciding intended behavior.
Test universal headpieces, equip/unequip transitions, skill-requirement changes and reconnect; do not infer effects solely from visual full-set appearance.
Test temperature thresholds and resource caps, full-inventory equipment rejection and multiplayer/event ordering on copied saves.
